title: Speed of the made field: front, formation of the static mark and long range

key_results.statement: Field class, any $N_f$, $D$, $L$, either switching: $\langle\Phi_x\rangle_\lambda=N_f|\psi(x,\lambda)|^2$ exactly, and at first order in $g_s$ $\delta\rho(x,\lambda)=2n\int_0^\lambda g_s(\lambda')\operatorname{Im}\mathcal U(x-x_s,\lambda-\lambda')d\lambda'$ with $\mathcal U(r,s)=\langle x_s+r|e^{-ist_f\Lambda}|x_s\rangle$.
Static mark at first order: $\delta\rho_{\rm st}(r)=-(2ng_s/t_f)\Lambda^+(r)$.

Sudden switching, first order, $\lambda\ge0$: $\delta\rho=\delta\rho_{\rm st}+(2ng_s/t_f)R$, $R(r,\lambda)=|X_f|^{-1}\sum_{k\ne0}\cos(k\cdot r)\cos(t_f\omega\lambda)/\omega$; on the torus $R$ does not decay.

Exact propagator: $\mathcal U(r,s)=\sum_m\mathcal U_\infty(r+Lm,s)$, $\mathcal U_\infty=e^{-2iDt_fs}\prod_\mu i^{r_\mu}J_{r_\mu}(2t_fs)$, and $|\mathcal U_\infty|\le e^{-\rho\eta(2t_fs/\rho)}$ for $2t_fs\le\rho=\|r\|_\infty$ (Kapteyn).

Ahead of the front ($2t_f\lambda<\rho\le L/2$), first order, both switchings: $|\delta\rho|\le2n\lambda\max|g_s|\sum_m e^{-\rho_m\eta(2t_f\lambda/\rho_m)}$, exponentially small in $\rho$; with $2N_f$ in place of $2n$ for every start.

At the front, $D=1$, leading order in $r$ for $|2t_f\lambda-r|=O(r^{1/3})$: $\delta\rho=(ng_s/t_f)(2/r)^{1/3}\mathrm{Ai}((r-2t_f\lambda)/(r/2)^{1/3})\cos(r\pi/2-2t_f\lambda)$, envelope maximum $0.6749(n|g_s|/t_f)r^{-1/3}$; along an axis in $D$ dimensions the change at the front is of order $\rho^{-1/3-(D-1)/2}$.

Criterion: arrival when $|\delta\rho|\ge\varepsilon(n|g_s|/t_f)\rho^{-p}$, $p>1/3+(D-1)/2$; sudden switching, first order, $\rho\to\infty$, $\rho\le L/2$: $\lambda_a=\rho/(2t_f)+O(\rho^{1/3}(\ln\rho)^{2/3}/t_f)$, front speed $v_f=2t_f$ in the sup-norm of place labels (graph distance: $2t_f$ along axes, $2Dt_f$ along diagonals).

Behind the front, $L\to\infty$ first, $|r|\to\infty$ at fixed $\zeta=|r|^2/(4t_f\lambda)$, leading order: $\delta\rho\simeq-(2ng_s/t_f)\operatorname{Re}W_D(|r|,it_f\lambda)$ with $W_D(r,\Theta)=\int_0^\Theta(4\pi s)^{-D/2}e^{-r^2/4s}ds$.

Same regime: gradient of the made field over gradient of the long-range static part $=g_D(\zeta)=\operatorname{Re}\Gamma(D/2,-i\zeta)/\Gamma(D/2)$; $1-g_1\simeq\sqrt{2\zeta/\pi}$, $1-g_2\simeq\zeta^2/2$, $1-g_3\simeq-4\zeta^{3/2}/(3\sqrt{2\pi})$ as $\zeta\to0$.

Sudden switching: the long-range part at distance $|r|$ is formed to accuracy $\varepsilon$ from $\lambda_{\rm form}=|r|^2/(4t_f\zeta_D(\varepsilon))$, $\zeta_1=\pi\varepsilon^2/2$, $\zeta_2=\sqrt{2\varepsilon}$, $\zeta_3=(3\sqrt{2\pi}\varepsilon/4)^{2/3}$ at leading order in $\varepsilon$, independent of $L$; on the torus valid up to the wrap time $(L-\rho)/(2t_f)$.

Sudden switching, torus, first order: the running $\lambda$-average of $\delta\rho$ tends to $\delta\rho_{\rm st}$ with error at most $(2n|g_s|/t_f)S_2/(t_f\Lambda)$, $S_2=|X_f|^{-1}\sum_{k\ne0}\omega^{-2}=O(L^{4-D})$; the instantaneous field does not converge.

Gradual switching, first order: $\delta\rho-(g_s(\lambda)/g_s)\delta\rho_{\rm st}=\frac{2n}{t_f|X_f|}\sum_{k\ne0}\frac{\cos(k\cdot r)}{\omega}\int_0^\lambda g_s'\cos(t_f\omega(\lambda-\lambda'))d\lambda'$, equal to $\frac{2ng_s}{t_f|X_f|}\sum\frac{\cos(k\cdot r)}{\omega}\operatorname{Re}[e^{-it_f\omega\lambda}F(t_f\omega T)]$ for $\lambda\ge T$.

Gradual switching, $T\ll L^2/t_f$, leading order: the gradient at $|r|$ follows the static one within $\varepsilon$ on $[0,2T]$ for every $T\ge T_{\rm form}=|r|^2/(t_f\nu_D(\varepsilon;f))$, $\nu_D\propto\varepsilon^{2/D}$, deviation $O((|r|^2/t_fT)^{D/2})$; the level follows only for $T\gtrsim L^2/(4\pi^2t_f)$ in $D=1$.

In the class, for every fixed $\kappa>0$ and $\varepsilon<1/2$: $\lambda_{\rm form}>\kappa|r|/t_f$ and $T_{\rm form}>\kappa|r|/t_f$ for all large $|r|$; the long-range part forms only on $\lambda\propto|r|^2/t_f$ although the front speed is finite.

Control (field objects with more places and pair terms among them, harmonic lattice, $D=3$): $\langle q\rangle-\langle q\rangle_{k=0}\simeq-\frac{g_s}{4\pi\kappa|r|}\theta(\sqrt\kappa\lambda-|r|)$, so the long-range part forms at the front, linearly in $|r|$.

Control for item 1 (hopping $\propto|x-y|^{-\alpha}$ on the ring, $\alpha>1$): $\delta\rho(r,\lambda_1)=ng_st_f\lambda_1^2|r|^{-\alpha}(1+O((t_f\lambda_1)^2))$, so the arrival time stays bounded for $p>\alpha$: no finite front speed.
Speeds: $v_f/\tau=2t_f/\tau$; a Model D body moving along an axis of the field moves more slowly than the front of the field iff $\tau<2t_f$.

open_issues: The size of the wrapped changes on the torus after the wrap time is not derived for the sudden switching; instantaneous formation statements hold up to the wrap time or with L→∞ first.
The constants ν_D(ε; f) of (8.13) are not given in closed form, and D=2 is not checked numerically.
Second order in g_s and starts other than the lowest state: only (8.5) is derived for every start.
How far out the long-range mark of a moving body is formed is open, since the long-range part forms only on |r|²/t_f; moving sources are out of scope.
(8.17) rests on identifying the body's position label with the field place along an axis; the relation to the distances of 03-ilang-space is out of scope.
Whether a field with linear long-wavelength frequencies, as in (8.15), is selected by anything in the language (item 5) is not addressed.

consistency_checks.check: Static limit: the λ-average of (8.3) reproduces (8.2), i.e. (4.4) of 06-ilang-source/04-profile, and Θ→∞ in the gradient of (8.8) gives the distance dependence of (4.4) of 07-ilang-weight/04-weight-of-bond
Sum rule Σ_x δρ(x,λ)=0 at every λ, matching Σ M^(2)=0 of (4.4)
Dimensions of δρ, ζ, ν, the speeds and the scales
